input.headline: South Africa's government formally establishes a presidential advisory commission of academic, business and civil society leaders to advise on new digital-era technologies.

input_full.excerpt: The South African government established a commission (consisting of leaders from academia, business and civil society) to generate a comprehensive view of South Africa's current conditions as well as the prospects in the Fourth Industrial Revolution. The Commission acknowledged that AI is one of the high-technology industries in which the country is "seriously underperforming", but notes that it also has "a unique opportunity to take stock of [its] vast potential in the form of human capacity, identify opportunities consistent with promoting a human centred, Africa-centric strategy for the future".
